title: Webtoon & Responsive Scroll Authoring Preview
objective: Support long-scroll/webtoon project grammar, insert/remove vertical space, responsive device/smartphone preview, scroll reading-order proof and governed split/single-file export profiles without weakening ordinary page-comic identity.
acceptance: Long-scroll/webtoon authoring extends existing SAA project/page/panel/layer identity rather than creating a parallel comic document model.
Insert/remove vertical space operations are explicit reversible authoring operations with stable affected panel/layer identities.
Responsive device and smartphone preview are presentation projections only and cannot mutate canonical page/panel/layer state.
Scroll reading-order proof is deterministic and preserves explicit authoring order across responsive projections.
Split and single-file webtoon export profiles are explicit governed profiles and do not silently authorize publication or network upload.
Ordinary page-comic identity remains valid and unchanged when scroll/webtoon presentation is absent.
SAA-25 reference staging and all earlier Character/Scene/ARI/PAPT/PCA authority boundaries remain sealed.
SAA-27 and later print/multimedia/interchange/publication behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-26 owns long-scroll/webtoon authoring grammar and responsive preview/export-profile semantics only.
No duplicate comic document, page/panel/layer, Character, Scene, ARI, renderer or narrative ledger may be created.
Preview projections cannot become canonical layout truth or silently rewrite ordinary page-comic identity.
Export profiles do not authorize commercial publication, provider upload or external side effects.
Provider-off/local authoring and preview remain valid.
SAA-27 remains blocked until verified SAA-26 closeout.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue before governed-starting SAA-26.
